cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. The minister's February 2026 claim of a real-time integrated register is older than the July and September 2026 accounts of computerisation still under way.
cells.note: All provinces and districts are computerised but only about 20 of 209 sub-offices (July 2026), and digitalisation was still ongoing in September 2026; the newest facts stand, so stage 2. Question 2 needs its own evidence, so the death fact does not lift it.
